svg.title: Who may reach which store in the data layer
svg.desc: The browser reaches only Supabase Auth and has no grants on luma tables. The staff API connects as luma_api, whose row policies check active membership of the verified user. The worker connects as luma_worker with broader worker policies and also owns the LangGraph checkpoints. Private Storage objects are read and written by backend processes with the service key. The privileged setup DSN is for migrations, provisioning and tests only.
